author: CC
prose: The outside-readers census (cairn/tools/artifact/outside_readers.py) counts as inside only the house cairn and CairnCommons paths. Every git worktree and every clone of those two repos under ~/dev/src is scanned as an outside root, and its own code is reported as outside readers. Measured 2026-11-16 on akiendelllinux: 101 roots, 72 of them wt-*; 808,830 readers and 56,873 mentions; 510 s wall (424 s user) at load 2.3-3.5. Earlier the same day: 565,192 files walked, 453,712 under wt-*. Orchestrator's ruling: a worktree or clone of the house repos counts as inside; cast it as its own ticket, owned by the component that owns the proof (cairn/tools/artifact), after 6ea3a8548493.
